title: Netbox Canonical Event
description: Every check result, HL7 metadata event, heartbeat, update event, and security-signal event written by the Netbox device agent. PHI is explicitly excluded when phi_mode is false; the sidecar's code path does not hold raw content past metadata extraction. security_signal (Step 1, ransomware/posture) is NOT a status event (up/down) — it carries `signal`/`severity` and requires a `security_signal_payload` object, gated by the same if/then pattern as hl7_metadata. This schema is the single source of truth for the agent (TS), the sidecar (Python), and the ingestion API once both sides ship.

message_type.description: HL7v2 message type / trigger event e.g. ADT, ORU, ORM

correlation_token.description: per-device keyed HMAC-SHA256, used to later prove identical messages across hops without holding raw identifiers

source.description: adapter tag: graph-audit | graph-signin | backup-proxy | backup-api

observed.description: raw fields the agent actually saw (e.g. 'new admin: id, role, dts')

basis.description: why this is unusual (rationale string used by Fleet Console)

freshness_s.description: seconds since the observation was recorded at the device

channel_id.description: Optional interface-engine channel stable id (e.g. a Mirth channel name/id) this observation belongs to. Used by the Fleet Console per-site topology view to group check_results under their interface channels — never required, never PHI, just a routing label.

phi_mode.description: false = raw HL7 body was never in memory after metadata extraction (a structural guarantee, not merely a flag). true only after signed amendment enables it.
